title: Institutional synthetics: VMM is the disclosed OTC principal
summary: Direct institutional synthetics are VMM-owned contracts. The client is disclosed to VMM for KYC/master agreement/collateral, while Federation receives no product-service reference or portfolio entitlement.
invariants: Reference snapshots preserve current legal owner and legacy source-book/succession evidence.
Contractual payoff, premium/collateral cash, and VMM risk/XVA/hedge-effectiveness evidence remain separate.
Synthetic hedges carry a VMM contract reference into smart execution, not the client's raw portfolio.
Novation is tripartite and creates a new contract; the old contract is not renamed in place.

provenance.claim: Direct institutional OTC boundary, portfolio snapshot provenance, VMM risk and Federation exclusion.
